beschreibung: A small German town market square on a sunny autumn afternoon. In the foreground, three adults stand together and chat beside a parked dark green vintage sedan; their faces are clearly visible and turned towards the camera at slightly different angles: a woman in her thirties with a beige trench coat, an older man with grey hair and glasses, a younger man with a dark jacket. The sedan's front licence plate is a white German plate with a blue EU band on the left, with the black letters "XZ-KL 482". Behind them, on a stone pedestal, a weathered bronze statue of a seated man with a book. On the right a small red hatchback is parked, its rear licence plate reads "QM-AT 1907". Half-timbered houses, café umbrellas and a few passers-by in the background.
